scope: Read-only technical audit of the 28 existing image files reused by the Clan Ship operations catalogue. No raster altered or created.

method.readMode: Read bytes; verify container; fully decode first frame; inspect alpha in memory; rehash original file afterward.
method.opaqueFiles: For files with no stored alpha/transparency, effective alpha is 255 for analysis only. No channel is written to disk.
method.dimensions: Decoded source pixel dimensions; never the displayed CSS width/height.
method.declaredAlphaBounds: Compared only where the source explicitly declares an alpha threshold; these observations do not impose a new artistic threshold.

limits: No human artistic or lore 1:1 approval is claimed.
A non-empty alpha mask and transparency do not prove clean edges, correct silhouette, scale, anatomy or visual fidelity.
No browser rendering, interaction, sound, animation, collision, rights or licence qualification is inferred from this decode audit.
Only the 28 catalogue image files are covered. Code SVG projections and future resources are outside this image-file audit.
An opaque room background is accepted; absence of a stored alpha channel is not reported as a defect for that category.
